company_name: Sae Han Micro Tech Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Sae Han Micro Tech specializes in high-precision probe pins and customized probe card components for the semiconductor test industry.
summary: Sae Han Micro Tech Co., Ltd. is a South Korean manufacturer focused on designing and producing high-precision probe pins and components for semiconductor testing. With over two decades of experience, the company provides advanced contact solutions that enhance test yield and cost efficiency for wafer-level and final test applications.
capabilities: Ultra-fine pitch and high-aspect ratio spring pins
Custom-designed pogo pins and interposer contacts
Full in-house fabrication and surface treatment capabilities

regional_presence.Korea: The company is headquartered in South Korea and collaborates closely with leading probe card manufacturers and device makers worldwide.
